# Robins Kaplan LLP

> Award-winning litigation firm with 225+ attorneys specializing in intellectual property, complex disputes, and trial advocacy across 7 major U.S. cities.

Robins Kaplan LLP is a prominent law firm known for its expertise in IP litigation, bankruptcy law, and complex commercial disputes. The firm maintains a strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, along with extensive pro bono work and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Intellectual Property
- Trial Advocacy
- Litigation Practice
- Patent Law (PTAB, Hatch-Waxman)
- Bankruptcy Law
- Complex Disputes
- Settlements & Verdicts
- Attorney Recruitment
- Legal Insights
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Pro Bono Services
- Federal Judicial Clerkships
- Minneapolis Office
- Silicon Valley Office
- Legal Project Management
